_comment: Copy to corpus.local.json (gitignored) and point `root` at clones on your own
disk. Paths are never committed: a corpus is personal to whoever runs it, and
These ten public projects are the corpus quoted in the README. They are
unaffiliated with this one and were chosen for a spread of size and layout,
not for flattering results. Recreate them with:
`commit` is what the README's figures were measured against; file counts and
timings drift as these projects change.
Tasks are phrased as a developer would describe the symptom. Keep at least one
whose words collide with the repo's own naming convention -- that is the known
weak case (see README, 'What it deliberately does not do').

tasks: option prompt does not hide the input
session cookie is not set on redirect
string normalization changes the wrong quotes
table column width ignores the terminal size
field validator not called on assignment
dependency override not applied in nested routers
indentation rule fires on a templated line
queryset filter drops the second condition
